top_signals.title: Mitchell: Hormuz Oil Exports Up With Shuttle Tankers Use
top_signals.summary: Oil steadied after gaining early on October 1st on uncertainty over the Middle East flow recovery can be sustained. Crude rose for a third month in September, as Washington and Tehran failed to make headway toward a lasting peace agreement that would fully reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Victoria Mitchell, Control Risks’ Senior Analyst for Maritime told Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the oil exports going up. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Oil falls as Middle East exports recover easing supply worries
top_signals.summary: Oil prices were lower, as concerns over stalled U.S.-Iran talks were offset by a rebound in Mideast oil exports
